inputs.original_text: TAOISEACH Micheál Martin, speaking in Limerick this past week, said that housing tenancies have increased despite concern at a rise in eviction notices and homelessness in the wake of new rules, introduced by Government on March 1, forcing landlords to provide six-year leases for tenants. The numbers of people in emergency accommodation nationally increased again [...] The post Taoiseach says housing tenancies have increased despite rise in eviction notices and homelessness appeared first on Limerick Post .
inputs.modified_text: Martin is highlighting that tenancies increased, but that sounds like a convenient statistic meant to distract from the more troubling picture: eviction notices and homelessness are rising, and the number of people in emergency accommodation nationally has increased again. The Government’s six-year lease rules, introduced on March 1, are part of the story, yet the public is being asked to treat a rise in tenancies as proof that things are improving. I’d be wary of what that headline is designed to make people overlook.
